note: Authored from docs/spec; expected facts are derived by tools/fixtures/movement, not by packages/core. No state or draw hashes: later entries assert those.
tick: 60 Hz fixed; phases input, waits, threads, movement, edges, triggers, animation (AD-26)
units: board pixels; fractions are exact multiples of 1/256

corpus.note: The battle-trigger case is reachable in the corpus (man.prg calls fightEnemy), so no authored equivalent was needed. Board geometry is an authored stand-in: this generator decodes no legacy board or item file.

cases.name: wander-when-the-player-is-far
cases.note: man_wander.prg with the player beyond 96 px: the item picks a random point within range 256 (two scripted draws per wander) and pathfinds there with the thread paused; the second goal is off the board, so the nearest free node is used; the thread then sleeps 0.5 s (30 ticks).

cases.name: intercept-but-the-player-keeps-moving
cases.note: Inside 96 px the item pathfinds to the player's location (the blocked goal becomes the nearest free node); the player has moved on by the time it arrives, so no event runs and the loop repeats.
